verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Scribe accepts audio and video uploads in many formats, hosted URLs, and async webhook processing. No item states a maximum duration or file size, or confirms that multi-hour recordings are accepted in a single job. Format breadth and async processing are adjacent features, not the documented limits this story requires.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-hour recordings are accepted in a single job, with the maximum duration and file size documented
